why: The conjecture (every cubic bipartite 3-connected planar graph is Hamiltonian) remains open per its Wikipedia article (updated Dec 2025) and search results; the 2025 GD conference paper 'Approximating Barnette's Conjecture' proves only a subhamiltonian cycle bound (5n/6 edges), explicitly leaving the actual Hamiltonicity conjecture open, so it does not move the stated problem.

found.title: Approximating Barnette's Conjecture
found.note: Proves a 5n/6-edge subhamiltonian cycle bound in Barnette graphs; explicitly does not resolve the Hamiltonicity conjecture itself.
